evals.prompt: agent roster audit: which model does each agent use

Roster audit — which model each agent uses: node 00-meta-skills/agent-roster/scripts/set-models.mjs --list
Tier semantics: strong = gentle-orchestrator, jd-judge-a, jd-judge-b and sdd-apply (4 agents); flash = the other 16 (delegate_only=true per entry, except sdd-onboard which runs inline).

Regenerate, never edit by hand: roster.json is the only source; runtimes are projected from it with apply.mjs (dry-run first).
